title: FFPE Tissue Sectioning for CODEX
author: Marda Jorgensen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8mfhu3n
materials: Section the tissue between 5-10 µm thick.

steps.title: Prepare 40 °C water bath
steps.instruction: Set up a water bath at 40 °C and place it next to the microtome.

steps.title: Prepare clean dry surface
steps.instruction: Prepare a clean, dry surface for laying the coverslips next to the microtome.

steps.title: Clean coverslips with aerosol spray
steps.instruction: Use an aerosol spray to clean coverslips from dust and lint prior to use.

steps.title: Insert new microtome blade
steps.instruction: Insert a new blade for sectioning each block.

steps.title: Place tissue in water bath
steps.instruction: Place the sectioned tissue in the water bath for a few seconds and observe it expanding.

steps.title: Transfer tissue onto coverslip
steps.instruction: When the observed expansion is sufficient to remove folds and wrinkles, use forceps to quickly place a poly‑lysine‑coated coverslip in the water bath and gently move it upward so the tissue adheres to the coverslip as it is lifted out of the bath.

substeps.instruction: Confirm tissue expansion removes folds and wrinkles.
Using forceps, quickly place the poly‑lysine‑coated coverslip in the water bath.
Gently move the coverslip upward, allowing the tissue to lay on it and exit the bath.

steps.title: Air‑dry coverslip overnight
steps.instruction: Put the coverslip on a clean surface with the tissue facing up and let it air‑dry overnight.

steps.title: Repeat for each slice
steps.instruction: Repeat steps 5–7 for each tissue slice.

steps.title: Store dried tissue slides
steps.instruction: When the tissues are dry, place each tissue coverslip in an individual slot of a storage box, cover the box with the lid, and keep the box at 4 °C for up to 6 months.

substeps.instruction: Place each coverslip in an individual slot of the storage box.
Cover the storage box with its lid.
Store the box at 4 °C for up to 6 months.
